author: EHT Collaboration; registered image aperture assembled by Universe Scales
note: The real 2017 EHT reconstructed radio sky image (EHT Collaboration; ESO eso1907a), on a flat circular sky-plane aperture. The intensity ridge is registered approximately to the reported 42 ± 3 microarcsec emission-ring diameter at 16.8 Mpc (~105.6 billion km). The catalog’s ~103 billion km refers to this ring/shadow scale, not the event horizon. A feathered aperture cuts the outskirts at 1.24 ring diameters, preserving the intensity ridge. No 3D plasma, accretion geometry, or solid hole is inferred; rotation exposes a flat image. Orange is the published radio-intensity color mapping, not visible-light fire.

operations: Retain actual EHT color image; no generated replacement pixels
Fit approximate intensity ridge in the published JPEG, not a calibrated FITS/WCS image
Feather the circular aperture with vertex alpha beyond the intensity ridge; preserve square pixel aspect ratio
